scope.method: Source inspection and HTTP Range reads of all 12 safetensors headers; no model inference

conclusion.reason: The GLM CUDA EXL3 path only admits 4-bit mcg routed experts with BF16 elsewhere. This checkpoint uses mul1 at mixed widths and EXL3 dense, MTP, output-head and vision tensors.
conclusion.engineering_direction: Adapt upstream native GLM loading and operations to the existing generic EXL3 mul1 and variable-width kernels, with a TP1 launcher. This is an implementation recommendation, not runtime validation.

blockers.finding: TP is restricted to 2 or 3; TP1 is rejected.
Both v1.1.1 and audited main require integer bits=4 and codebook=mcg. SC 2.10 fails this admission.
Requires int16 trellis last dimension 64 and .mcg marker; selected model has .mul1 and mixed 2/3-bit routed experts.

blockers.component: Native GLM dense and MTP loading
blockers.finding: EXL3 branch loads non-routed linear projections as BF16 .weight; selected model stores these projections as EXL3. Removing admission alone is insufficient.
Existing floating-point/fused-qkv loading needs adaptation for selected quantized, split-projection vision tensors if vision is enabled.

reusable_components.finding: Common loader understands inst3/mcg/mul1 and multiple bit widths.
Common dense CUDA kernels include mul1 and whole-bit/half-bit variants.
Common expert kernels carry per-projection widths and codebook dispatch.
Rank 0 / world 1 is admitted; this establishes a TP1 code path, not successful full-model TP1 inference.

required_validation_after_implementation: Tensor decode and logits agreement against an EXL3 reference before speed optimization
TP1 full-model loading and measured peak memory including KV/cache/workspaces
MTP off/on correctness, acceptance and throughput
Matched Korean and English thinking and non-thinking PP/TG measurements
Multi-turn tool calls, streaming/cancellation, and vision if enabled
Context lengths qualified separately; 1M is not established by file size
limitations: No full checkpoint download, service start, code patch or benchmark was performed.
Mia published TP2/4bpw/DFlash results do not establish TP1 SC 2.10 performance.
Mia patch files were inspected, not all applied to reconstruct a runtime.
The native GLM documentation contains stale backend claims; actual source was used for the assessment.
Weight file size alone is not the runtime memory requirement.
